subject: Phased onboarding & commercial playbook for CareBridge pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carebridge.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.kim@carebridge.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot structure & timing - CareBridge + Redwood

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile and observability looked promising. We want to move from exploration to a short MAP (mutual action plan) that ties technical milestones to commercial commitments. High-level asks from the product and procurement teams:

- A 6–8 week evaluation plan focused on throughput and token-cost metrics (we're sensitive to token spend on clinical transcripts).
- Pricing tiers that unlock as we reach MAP milestones (pilot -> production ramp).
- Options for observability retention beyond the standard 30 days (we need 90–180 days for HITRUST review).
- A premium support add-on or credits during the ramp window.

Can you share a draft MAP and a suggested commercial playbook (pricing at each milestone, suggested commit levels, and any bundle options for retention + support credits)? Procurement would like a one‑pager for internal approval.

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, CareBridge Health
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carebridge.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot structure & timing - CareBridge + Redwood

Liam — great to hear. I've attached a working MAP spreadsheet and a draft commercial playbook for Procurement. Attachments: [MAP_v1.xlsx] [SOW_draft.docx].

Summary of our proposed phased MAP:
- Week 0–2 (Onboarding): model selection, baseline latency/cost bench, tenant setup (no commit).
- Week 3–5 (Eval): two perf gates (99th pct latency, token-cost per 1k) + prefix/KV cache test. Successful pass = candidate for ramp credit.
- Week 6–8 (Ramp): incremental commit window with reserved throughput and optional observability extension trial.

Commercial (playbook highlights):
- Evaluation phase: no minimum, use-hosted rates with capped monthly spend up to $10k (safety cap).
- Ramp trigger: upon passing perf gates, customer may elect a 3‑month ramp reservation (example: 2x baseline qps, 20% discount on hosted rate + $10k observability credit for retention extension).
- Production commit: 12‑month reserved capacity contract with stepped pricing based on committed GPU-hours; additional discounts for multi-year.

Bundles to consider (we can pre-bundle for Procurement one-pager):
1) Observability Plus: 90-day retention + 7 day extended traces + 10% discount on metrics retention over baseline.
2) Ramp Support Credits: $X credits for on-call support during the ramp (applied to overage or support hours).
3) Evaluations Pack: token credits and 2 eval seats for Redwood Optimize to propose quantization/choice recommendations.

Questions for you:
- Is the 90–180 day retention hard requirement for the pilot, or can we start at 90 and extend upon proof?
- Who from Procurement should we coordinate with on the one-pager?

I'll loop in Monica to sketch sample pricing math and a one-pager for procurement.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx]
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@carebridge.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carebridge.ai>, Procurement <procurement@carebridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot structure & timing - CareBridge + Redwood

Thanks Aditya — responding to the two quick items:

- Retention: For the HITRUST evidence window we need 120 days minimum for metrics and traces during the pilot. We could accept 90 if we get a written note that Redwood can extend to 120 once we hit a ramp milestone.
- Procurement: looping in procurement mailbox (procurement@carebridge.ai). They have a template for vendor pilots that requires a clear commit trigger and exit criteria.

Also: curious how the observability credit works in practice — is that an offset on our invoices, or a support package that covers extra data egress/storage?

-Sara
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@carebridge.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@carebridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot structure & timing - CareBridge + Redwood

Sara / Procurement team — thanks for the clarity. A few clarifications from our side (pricing + MAP gating):

1) Observability retention credit model:
- We can provide a time-limited observability extension as a credit applied to storage/retention charges for the pilot period. For example: 90 days retention at no additional charge for the first 60 days of the pilot, then 50% subsidized for the subsequent 60 days if a ramp commit is signed.
- If CareBridge requires a guaranteed 120-day retention for the entire pilot, we can do a one-time observability add-on SKU (priced in the one-pager).

2) Ramp credits and support:
- Ramp Support Credits: $15k credits that can be consumed for premium support hours or used to offset overage charges (applied as invoice credit within the quarter).
- Trigger: credits become billable/allocated once the eval perf gates are met and CareBridge elects the ramp reservation.

3) MAP gating and exit criteria (short version):
- Gate A (Week 2): tenant + baseline tests complete.
- Gate B (Week 5): perf gates met (latency + token-cost thresholds).
- If Gate B fails, we recommend a 2-week remediation with a pause on ramp credits; if remediation succeeds, rally to continue ramp.

4) Pricing examples (for one-pager):
- Eval (no commit): hosted rates, capped at $10k/month.
- Ramp reserve (3 months): commit equivalent to 2x baseline throughput; 20% discount on hosted unit rate + $15k ramp support credits + optional observability add-on.
- Production commit (12 mo): fixed monthly commit, deeper discounts, SLA uplift.

Attached is a stub one-pager I drafted (see SOW_draft.docx). I'll prepare the procurement-ready one-pager with two pricing options (90-day trial vs guaranteed 120-day retention).

Monica Patel
Principal Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOW_draft.docx]

2) CareBridge to confirm which option Procurement prefers; if Option B, we will include observability SKU price on the one-pager.
3) I'll upload the signed MAP spreadsheet and DocuSign SOW link once we have agreement.
